title: Map changed to Chernarus
body: The server has switched maps from Livonia to Chernarus.

title: Comrades Cassettes — 4 new songs added
body: Comrades Cassettes has been updated with 4 new songs.

title: Comrades Cola spawning confirmed
body: Comrades Cola is now spawning on the server as intended.

title: Fresh spawns now include a Comrades Cola
body: New characters now spawn with a Comrades Cola in their inventory.

title: Day/night acceleration adjusted
body: Day acceleration changed to 5.4. Night acceleration changed to 2.17.

title: AI accuracy lowered, MMG storage despawn fixes
body:
Lowered AI accuracy.
Fixed MMG_woodrack despawn issue.
Fixed MMG_wood_table despawn issue.

title: Server message errors — fix in progress
body: Found the reason behind the server message errors. A fix is in progress.

title: Now listed on DZSA Launcher
body: The server is now listed on DZSA Launcher, with the Discord invite linked.

title: Building Fortifications despawn fix
body: Fixed Building Fortifications pieces triggering the dynamic economy despawn cycle after being built.

title: Fire mode switch added to Mlock19
body: A full-auto / semi-auto fire mode switch has been added to the Mlock19.

title: Server switched to 1st person only
body: The server has been changed to 1st person only.

title: Comrades Cassettes updated
body: Comrades Cassettes (for Zen's Music) has been updated — added a few requested tracks plus 18 other misc songs.

title: Universal Suppressors V2 client fix
body: Fixed Universal Suppressors V2 not auto-loading for clients.

title: Comrades Cola spawn fixed
body: Fixed Comrades Cola not spawning. They'll remain an uncommon find, though.
